Subject: Trial boost request — inbound signup asking for additional eval credits

Hi Priyom,

We just completed a self-serve signup this morning and started running some LLM evaluation tests against your hosted API. Early results look promising, but we hit our trial cap after ~18k tokens. Our evaluation run for the week is likely to need ~200–300k tokens to get a representative sample.

Is there a path to get a one-off trial boost or short-term credit so we can finish the evaluation? We're evaluating Redwood as the runtime for a multi-model vector search pipeline and want to compare latency/cost at scale. If helpful, I attached the chat transcript from the self-serve flow and a screenshot of the usage page showing the cap.

High-level details:
- Company: NovaBrain (seed-stage, ML infra)
- Use case: API gen + embeddings for semantic retrieval benchmarking
- Expected eval: 200k–300k tokens over 7 days
- Billing contact: maya@novabrain.ai

Let me know what info you need to triage. We can also hop on a 20m call if that's easier.

Thanks,
Maya Lopez
Head of ML Ops
NovaBrain

Attachments: signup_chat_transcript.txt, usage_screenshot.png

Hi Maya — thanks for the details and the attachments. Welcome to Redwood!

I can triage this quickly. A couple quick asks so I can scope the right boost:
- Can you confirm whether the 200–300k token estimate is purely for generation or includes embeddings?
- Any preference on duration (7 days vs 14 days)? We often issue a one-time top-up tied to an account to run an evaluative workload.

I'm looping in Karthik (sales ops) to scope approvals — he'll advise on the credit size and any verification we need. If you prefer, we can provision a short-term boosted quota now while approvals are formalized.

If you have a short call window today I can also share best-practice batching/kv-cache settings that lower token spend significantly for eval runs.

—Priyom
